subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Vinod had a ______ escape in the car accident.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"narrow"** means something that is limited in width, especially in relation to length. (संकीर्ण)

 
 
• **Example:** The path was so** narrow** that only one person could walk at a time.
 
 
 
• **"Narrow escape"** refers to a situation where someone manages to avoid danger or disaster by a very small margin. (बाल-बाल बचना)
 
 
• **Example:** Vinod had a** narrow escape** in the car accident.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Comfortable** (आरामदायक): Providing physical ease and relaxation.

 
 
• **Example:** The sofa is very comfortable to sit on.
 
 
 
• **Full** (पूर्ण): Containing or holding as much or as many as possible.
 
 
• **Example:** The glass is full of water.
 
 
 
• **Wide** (चौड़ा): Of great or more than average width.
 
 
• **Example:** The river is very wide at this point.
 
 

36:Tb95,

The correct answer is: **Option 3**
